versions.notes: Long-standing rule; in force before this date. Earlier history is not modelled — effectiveFrom is the modelling baseline, not the date the rule was enacted. Employers with fewer than 11 employees must provide earned sick time but it may be unpaid. Verified via mass.gov content (direct page fetch blocked by bot protection; content confirmed through official-site search results) — reconfirm in legal review.

No scheduled increases after 2023. Must remain at least $0.50 above the federal minimum. Tipped service rate $6.75 and agricultural $8.00 not modelled. Verified via mass.gov content and DOL state table (https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/minimum-wage/state).

versions.notes: s. 3(a): a person that maintains or stores but does not own the data notifies the owner or licensor 'as soon as practicable and without unreasonable delay'; s. 3(b): the owner notifies the attorney general, the director of consumer affairs and business regulation and the resident, as soon as practicable and without unreasonable delay. Modelling baseline 2024-01-01.
